The '''Wing Guard Elite''' [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was a highly streamlined airborne [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] composed of veteran and [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] pulled from the [[1st Wing Guard]] and the [[2nd Wing Guard]] squadrons. Founded by [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and led by [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], the Wing Guard Elite helped to protect [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] new [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], reorganized the previously existing airborne security defense force&mdash;the [[1st Wing Guard]], a cloud car squadron division of the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]]&mdash;into the [[2nd Wing Guard]] by hiring commando pilots. The best pilots from the former 1st and the newly formed 2nd Wing Guards were eventually reassigned to Elite Wing Guard.<ref name="SWPM" />

When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] brought an occupation force to Cloud City, the 2nd Wing Guard became aligned with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]<ref name="SWPM" /> when [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]] and Lando orchestrated resistance against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and Calrissian departed with members of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Empire">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Description==
Based in the [[Cloud City Security Tower]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] Cloud City,<ref name="BWGITDB" /> the 2nd Wing Guard's [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] were painted [[Color/Legends|orange]] and offered minimal protection to the pilots who flew them.<ref name="SWPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wing Guard Elite was represented by two different miniatures in the ''[[Scum & Villainy]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''.<ref name="SWPM" />
